title: CrewDowned
description: A unit was lost and its crew survived the seeded roll (CONTRACTS §6; COMBAT CB-8, GAMEPLAY §6a): rolled once per unit with crew above 0, at the first of Disabled or Destroyed. The marker stays on the map for combat.crew_marker_min of game time. A lost crew emits nothing. pos is the unit position when it was lost. Public view: dropped unless the viewer side observes the position (FOW-13).

entity_id.description: The unit the crew belonged to.
